top_violation_types.title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The fire extinguisher was not mounted.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records Accessible - to Licensing (26 TAC §747.601(c))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A child did not have any records on file.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Notify Parents of Change in Operational Policy or Enrollment Agreement (26 TAC §746.505(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Operational policies were updated last April 15th, 2025 and enrollment records were reviewed and there was no written documentation in any of the children's admission records of the updated policies with a parent signature acknowledging receipt of the new policies.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the investigation and video, it was found that the caregiver did not demonstrate a high level of judgment or self-control.

top_violation_types.title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained I observed a caregiver pulling a child to the ground and holding in a restraint hold.

top_violation_types.title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A report was not made to Child Care Regulation for an incident that potentially posed a risk to children.

top_violation_types.title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Caregiver Must Face Child and Be Within Arm's Length of Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the information gathered a child was left unattended on the changing table.
